brandHeadline: Build a marketing workspace tailored to your brand
brandSubline: Turn strategy, approvals, tools, and execution into one operating system for your team.
brandBullet1Title: Turn strategy into launch-ready marketing workflows
brandBullet1Desc: Plan goals, generate workstreams, review changes, and launch across channels with approvals and auditability built in.
brandBullet2Title: Get a workspace tailored to your brand in minutes
brandBullet2Desc: We use your website, app, and tools to draft your Brand Center, recommend connectors, and suggest your first high-impact workstreams.
brandBullet3Desc: Give CRM, performance, creative, and compliance teams one place to plan, collaborate, approve, and execute safely.
agencyHeadline: Run client delivery with more structure and less chaos
agencySubline: Standardize how your agency plans, creates, reviews, launches, and reports across brands.
agencyBullet1Title: Standardize how your team delivers for every client
agencyBullet1Desc: Create repeatable strategy, creative, review, launch, and reporting workflows across brands and campaigns.
agencyBullet2Title: Go from brief to execution with less back-and-forth
agencyBullet2Desc: Bring strategy, creative ops, approvals, tools, and reporting into one operating system your team and clients can actually use.
agencyBullet3Title: Scale client work without scaling chaos
agencyBullet3Desc: Manage multiple brands, connect the tools each client uses, and keep approvals, evidence, and outputs organized in one place.
builtForTeams: Built for teams that need speed, structure, and approval controls.
